title_en: Bank of Communications, Nanchang Branch v. Seg Trust Company, Jiangxi Securities Trading Department — dispute over deposit payment
keywords_en: civil; deposit payment dispute; retrial; Supreme People's Court; Jiangxi Province; legal person; financial institution; Commercial Banking Law; determination of performance of payment obligation; effect of assisting court in freezing and deducting; reversal; deposit payment agreement; court freezing and deduction; assistance in enforcement; securities; application for retrial; deposit payment dispute at West Securities Trading Department
full_text_en:
[Bank of Communications, Nanchang Branch v. Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department — dispute over deposit payment]

[Ruling Summary]

Where a bank, after transferring the payable amount into the account of the depositor, subsequently complies with a court ruling and notice by performing its statutory assistance obligation to freeze and deduct the relevant funds, it shall be deemed to have fulfilled its payment obligation.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court
(2001) Min Er Ti Zi No. 7

Re-review Applicant (Defendant at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Bank of Communications, Nanchang Branch, domiciled at No. 25 Yongshu Road, Nanchang City.
Person in charge: Liu Maogui, President.
Agent ad litem: Yao Jianxin, staff member of the entity.
Agent ad litem: Tang Shaojun, attorney at Beijing Weituo Law Firm.

Respondent (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department, domiciled at No. 181 Supu Road, Nanchang City.
Person in charge: Wu Yafeng, General Manager.
Agent ad litem: Zhang Juntao, Deputy General Manager of the entity.
Agent ad litem: Ai Jianhua, attorney at Jiangxi Yuzhang Law Firm.

The re-review applicant, Bank of Communications, Nanchang Branch (hereinafter referred to as Nanchang Bank of Communications), in the case of dispute over deposit payment with Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department (hereinafter referred to as Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department), being dissatisfied with the civil judgment (2000) Gan Gao Fa Min Zhong Zi No. 85 of the Jiangxi High People's Court, applied to this Court for re-review. This Court rendered a civil ruling (2001) Min Er Jian Zi No. 215 on August 6, 2001, granting retrial of this case. This Court formed a collegiate panel in accordance with the law to hear this case, and the trial has now been concluded.

Facts Found by the Court:

On February 10, 1999, Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department opened a corporate deposit account (account number 60500371000832) at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications, and deposited RMB 20 million by check transfer on the same day. Subsequently, Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department used this account for business settlement. As of January 16, 2000, the deposit balance of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department was still over RMB 12 million. On January 17 of the same year, when Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department processed a transfer transaction, Nanchang Bank of Communications refused payment. On January 19 of the same year, Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department filed a lawsuit with the Nanchang Intermediate People's Court, requesting that the court order Nanchang Bank of Communications to immediately pay its deposit of RMB 12,706,708.35 and interest. On February 17, 2000, the parties voluntarily reached a deposit payment agreement, stipulating: 1. As of February 16, 2000, the deposit balance in the bank account (account number 60500371000832) opened by Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications was RMB 12,661,153.05. 2. Given that the cause of the deposit dispute between Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department and Nanchang Bank of Communications was the misappropriation of part of the deposit by the head of the Qinghua Sub-branch of the Bank of Communications and others, Nanchang Bank of Communications must pay the full amount of the above deposit and interest to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department within two months (counting from the effective date of this agreement). Specifically: pay the principal of RMB 2,661,153.05 before February 18; pay the principal of RMB 10 million on April 17; and at the same time on April 17, pay all interest (interest calculated based on inter-bank transaction rates). 3. If Nanchang Bank of Communications fails to perform its payment obligation in accordance with Article 2 of this agreement, Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department has the right to file a lawsuit with the people's court and claim compensation from Nanchang Bank of Communications for economic losses. On the day after the agreement was signed, Nanchang Bank of Communications paid Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department the principal of RMB 2,661,153.05. On April 17, 2000, Nanchang Bank of Communications did not pay the remaining amount as agreed. On May 31, 2000, Nanchang Bank of Communications transferred the principal of RMB 10 million and interest of RMB 102,428.43 into the deposit account of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications. On the same day of the transfer, the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province, upon application by Bank of Communications, Wuhan Branch (hereinafter referred to as Wuhan Bank of Communications), froze the deposit. On June 1, Nanchang Bank of Communications delivered the deposit slip, statement of account, and list of accrued deposit interest for the above amount to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department; Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department was unable to withdraw the funds because the deposit was frozen.

Further findings: In the case of a loan contract dispute heard by the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province between plaintiff Wuhan Bank of Communications and defendants China Everbright Foreign Trade Hubei Company, China Everbright Foreign Trade Corporation, and third party Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Hainan Saige Company), on May 29, 2000, Wuhan Bank of Communications applied to the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province for property preservation, requesting the freezing of RMB 11 million in deposits held by Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department, a branch of the third party Hainan Saige Company. On May 30 of the same year, the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province made civil ruling (2000) Han Jing Chu Zi No. 016-1, freezing RMB 11 million in deposits of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department, a branch of Hainan Saige Company, at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications, account number 60500371000832. On May 31, 2000, the deposit of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department in this account was frozen. On October 19 of the same year, the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province made civil ruling (2000) Han Jing Chu Zi No. 016-2, lifting the freeze on the above-mentioned deposit of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications, on the grounds that Wuhan Bank of Communications had withdrawn its lawsuit against the third party Hainan Saige Company. On October 20 of the same year, the said deposit of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications was unfrozen.

Also found: On October 18, 2000, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court, upon application by the enforcement applicant China Everbright Foreign Trade Corporation, made civil ruling (2000) Yi Zhong Zhi Zi No. 1074, freezing and deducting USD 1 million and interest from the bank deposits of the enforcement respondent Hainan Saige Company. On October 20 of the same year, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court issued a notice of assistance in deducting deposits to the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications. On the same day, the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications transferred RMB 10 million from the deposit of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department to the account of Wuhan Bank of Communications as the payee.

Additionally found: The subsidiary ledger and statement of account of Nanchang Bank of Communications recorded that on May 31, 2000, the deposit balance of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's account was RMB 10,102,428.48.

The Nanchang Intermediate People's Court of Jiangxi Province held at first instance that the deposit relationship between the parties genuinely existed. It was wrong for Nanchang Bank of Communications to refuse payment of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's deposit because its internal personnel had misappropriated the deposit. Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's claim that Nanchang Bank of Communications should redeem the deposit was reasonable and lawful and should be supported. The deposit redemption agreement voluntarily reached by the parties during litigation was valid, and both parties should perform in accordance with the agreement. The RMB 2,661,153.05 already paid by Nanchang Bank of Communications should be deducted from the deposit. Based on this, the court ruled: Within ten days after this judgment takes effect, Nanchang Bank of Communications shall redeem the deposit of RMB 10 million and interest to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department from account number 60500371000832, with interest calculated at inter-bank transaction rates from February 17, 2000 until the date of full payment. The case acceptance fee of RMB 73,544 and the litigation preservation fee of RMB 53,020, totaling RMB 126,564, shall be borne by Nanchang Bank of Communications. Nanchang Bank of Communications, being dissatisfied, appealed to the Jiangxi High People's Court.

The Jiangxi High People's Court held at second instance that Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department had opened an account at a sub-branch under Nanchang Bank of Communications and deposited funds, thereby forming a genuine deposit relationship between them, which should be protected by law. The deposit payment agreement signed by the parties was a true expression of their intentions, and its content did not violate any prohibitive provisions of laws or regulations; therefore, the agreement should be found valid. Nanchang Bank of Communications failed to pay the principal of RMB 10 million and interest to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department on April 17 as agreed, constituting a breach of contract, and should bear liability for breaching the contract by paying the principal and interest of the deposit. Nanchang Bank of Communications' argument that there was no certificate of deposit dispute between the parties and that the Supreme People's Court's Certain Provisions on the Trial of Certificate of Deposit Dispute Cases should not apply was valid, but its claim that the parties had reached an oral agreement to pay the deposit only after approval from the head office was inconsistent with the facts. Nanchang Bank of Communications' argument that it had completed its payment obligation by transferring the funds into Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's account and that the freezing of the deposit was unrelated to it was not in compliance with the terms of the agreement and was untenable; this Court does not support it. The court of first instance, in ruling that Nanchang Bank of Communications should pay the deposit and interest based on the deposit payment agreement voluntarily reached by the parties, made no error in substantive disposition and should be affirmed. Accordingly, the court ruled: Appeal dismissed, original judgment affirmed. The second instance case acceptance fee of RMB 73,544 shall be borne by Nanchang Bank of Communications.

Nanchang Bank of Communications applied to this Court for retrial, asserting: The applicant had already performed its payment obligation under the agreement between the parties; the funds were frozen and eventually deducted by the court due to the respondent's involvement in other cases, and the fault did not lie with the applicant. The original judgment failed to recognize the important fact that the RMB 10 million in this case was deducted by the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court, and did not adopt the applicant's argument that freezing the deposit and transferring it pursuant to a court ruling was the performance of a statutory assistance obligation. Ordering the applicant to pay another RMB 10 million to the respondent had no legal basis. Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department responded: The reason and responsibility for the respondent's inability to withdraw the deposit lay with Nanchang Bank of Communications. Nanchang Bank of Communications' unjustified refusal to pay the respondent's deposit infringed upon the respondent's interests and violated relevant provisions of the Commercial Banking Law. Nanchang Bank of Communications' failure to perform its payment obligation under the Deposit Payment Agreement constituted a breach of contract, causing significant economic losses to the respondent; Nanchang Bank of Communications should bear liability for breach of contract and compensation. Nanchang Bank of Communications forged the deposit slip and payment notice, constituting major fraud. According to relevant legal provisions, the Hanjiang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province and the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court should not have frozen or enforced against the respondent's investor margin funds and deposits. The second instance judgment of the Jiangxi High People's Court had accurate findings of fact, correct application of law, and protected the lawful rights and interests of the depositor, and should be affirmed.

Opinion of the Court: Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department opened a general deposit account at the Qinghua Sub-branch under Nanchang Bank of Communications and deposited funds for settlement, forming a genuine deposit relationship between the parties. The cause of the deposit dispute was the misappropriation of part of the deposit by the head of the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications and others, and Nanchang Bank of Communications' refusal to pay the deposit led to the dispute. During the resolution of the dispute, the parties voluntarily reached a Deposit Payment Agreement on February 17, 2000. This agreement was a true expression of the parties' intentions, and its content did not violate the law; therefore, it should be found valid. On May 31, 2000, Nanchang Bank of Communications transferred the principal of RMB 10 million and interest of RMB 102,428.43 into the deposit account of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department at the Qinghua Sub-branch of Nanchang Bank of Communications, as evidenced by the deposit slip, statement of account, list of accrued deposit interest, and subsidiary ledger. It should be found that Nanchang Bank of Communications had fulfilled its payment obligation of RMB 10 million principal and interest to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department. The freezing of these funds and the eventual deduction of RMB 10 million to Wuhan Bank of Communications' account to offset the debt owed by Hainan Saige Company, the parent company of Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department, to Wuhan Bank of Communications, was Nanchang Bank of Communications' performance of its statutory assistance obligation pursuant to a court ruling and notice. Since Nanchang Bank of Communications had already completed its payment obligation to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department, it should not be required to pay another RMB 10 million to Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department. The grounds for Nanchang Bank of Communications' retrial application are valid and should be supported by this Court. Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's defense that Nanchang Bank of Communications failed to perform its payment obligation and should bear liability for breaching the contract due to non-payment cannot be established. The second instance judgment found that Nanchang Bank of Communications transferred the principal of RMB 10 million and interest of RMB 102,428.43 into Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's deposit account, but failed to find that Nanchang Bank of Communications had performed its payment obligation of RMB 10 million. This clearly constituted an error in the application of law and should be corrected. Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department argued in its response that Nanchang Bank of Communications forged the deposit slip and payment notice, constituting major fraud, but failed to provide corresponding evidence to prove this; this Court does not support it. Additionally, Hainan Saige Jiangxi Securities Trading Department's argument in its response that the funds executed were investor margin funds was also unsupported by evidence, and this Court likewise does not support it. Pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. The civil judgment (2000) Hong Min Yi Chu Zi No. 4 of the Nanchang Intermediate People's Court of Jiangxi Province and the civil judgment (2000) Gan Gao Fa Min Zhong Zi No. 85 of the Jiangxi High People's Court are vacated.
2. The claims of Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department are dismissed.

The first instance case acceptance fee of RMB 73,544 and litigation preservation fee of RMB 53,020, totaling RMB 126,564, shall be borne by Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department. The second instance case acceptance fee of RMB 73,544 shall be borne by Hainan Saige International Trust and Investment Corporation, Jiangxi Securities Trading Business Department.

This judgment is final.

Presiding Judge: Mao Duanzhi
Judge: Dou Hanwei
Acting Judge: Jia Jing
January 23, 2003
Clerk: Wang Yunfei
